generator_records.note: Structured generator records recognised by image_metadata.generator_record — deterministic/synthetic/strong, self-declared (the same rule as an A1111 parameters text or a ComfyUI graph in a tool field: evidence_rules.image_metadata_evidence). A key name alone, or a brand word alone, is not a record (the brand rule above gives moderate).
